note: Auto-download manifest. The engine fetches this (ModelDownloader.fetchManifest), downloads each url into the app's models dir, and verifies sha256. v4 moves OCR to NCNN — mixed precision: fp16 backbone + fp32 transformer via ncnn's per-layer featmask plus an explicit Cast layer; the sinusoidal positional encoding is fed as a second input, so any strip width works. On-device it is ~23% faster than the previous ORT int8 model and reads the small kana int8 got wrong (241/242 lines matching fp32 on 9 pages, vs 223/242 for int8). The engine no longer depends on ONNX Runtime. The _mixed param needs an arm82 (fp16) CPU — the engine falls back to the plain param otherwise; both params share one .bin. Detector (models-v3) and inpaint (models-v2) are unchanged and their urls still point at those releases. NCNN roles ship as .param + .bin (all files required). Translation weights (detector/ocr/inpainter) are GPL-3.0; see docs/MODELS.md. Urls point at this repo's GitHub release assets. v5 adds role "charseg" (night-reading character masks, backend ncnn, both fp16): manga_seg_s (YOLO11-seg, 20 MB) + cartoonseg (CartoonSegmentation RTMDet-Ins, 126 MB), unioned on device (~1.2-1.4 s/page). They are downloaded with everything else but only the night-reading renderer (NightReadRenderer) uses them; translation readiness does not depend on them. Their licensing differs from the GPL-3.0 translation weights: see each charseg entry's license/note (redistributed for research/non-commercial use with attribution; removed on rights-holder request; bring-your-own-model works). Translation roles (detector v3, ocr v4, inpainter v2) are unchanged and still point at those releases.

models.name: dbnet_detect.ncnn.param
models.note: DBNet (m-i-t default detector). resize_aspect to 1024 (pad to 256 multiples); rectangular input avoids ncnn's 832-992 square crash band. fp16 storage (153MB); int8 quant drops all boxes so not used.

models.name: ocr_48px_ctc.ncnn.param
models.note: 48px CTC OCR on NCNN (parity/export_ocr_ncnn.py). Plain param: every layer at the net's global precision — the engine loads this one whenever the _mixed param can't be used (CPU without arm82 fp16, or fp16 storage turned off). Positional encoding is the second input (in1, T = floor(W/4) - 1), so any strip width works. Shares ocr_48px_ctc.ncnn.bin with the _mixed param.

models.name: ocr_48px_ctc_mixed.ncnn.param
models.note: Mixed-precision param, the default on arm82 (asimdhp) CPUs: backbone convs fp16, transformer + char_pred forced to fp32 via per-layer featmask 31=7, with an explicit Cast (fp16 -> fp32) between them. Only valid with fp16 storage on the CPU — elsewhere the Cast would read fp32 as fp16, so the engine falls back to the plain param. Same .bin as the plain param (weight order unchanged).

models.name: ocr_48px_ctc.ncnn.bin
models.note: Weights (fp16 storage, ~83 MB; the retired int8 ONNX was 44 MB). Shared by both OCR params — always ship it from the same conversion as the params.

models.name: mit_aot_fixed512.ncnn.param
models.note: AOT-GAN manga inpaint (m-i-t). Fully-convolutional; run at whole-page tile 768 by default.
